notes.title: BossAss V1.1.3 is out now! Attach an update description.
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Players:[/h2]

This update focuses on fixing issues and does not add any new features.
We're preparing a[b] little surprise[/b] for everyone, and when it's ready, it's going to be presented to you!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090244/705c6f09cbb7f0f7ce3f729450928b1892e72558.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090244/3e2b09f9434152d23cdaf95ae32bc0fa17878544.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The following is the content of this update:[/h2]

[h3]BUG Fix[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixes an issue that caused the plot text to appear incomplete;
[*] Fixes an issue where the player immediately becomes stuck when the game is cleared when he ticks Skip The Opening Story;
[*] Fixes some of the previously discovered abnormal text displays;
[/olist]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Minor adjustments have been made to the effect of the plot text display;
[/olist]


TOWA Software
October 5, 2020.

notes.title: BossAss V1.1.2 is out now! Attach an update description.
BossAss is now officially released!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090244/4060e7e02b2d33f9e60ca68aa8225d03a62f4c1d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090244/e72ba5c3f05333ac832321180dcea6085d0cfe1b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Dear Players:[/h2]

We are pleased to announce that Rookie Society Animals will not dream of the boss's ass is now on sale! According to our previous plan, we will discount the game by -40% during the first period, at a discount of RMB ￥6.

The game's producers are live at the moment, so you can go and watch it.

Live address: [url=https://live.bilibili.com/7998605/]live.bilibili.com/7998605/ (BiliBIli)[/url]

Please don't miss it!

Have fun!



TOWA Software.
Moespirit Studios.

October 3, 2020.


[b]We will add additional languages to the game based on subsequent reactions![/b]

notes.title: Boss Ass will go on sale tonight!

[b]Dear Players:[/b]

As the publisher of our work, we are pleased to announce that the strategy game [i]Boss Ass[/i], developed by TOWA Software, will go on sale tonight!

In [i]Boss Ass[/i], you'll play a budding wage slave, join a long-established start-up, struggle with life in confusion and distress, and finally [strike]dream of the boss's ass[/strike] sitting in the boss's position!


[h3]Game information[/h3]

[/list]
